newsitem.title: CANADA: Air Canada regional pilots set to strike.
newsitem.headline: Air Canada regional pilots set to strike.

text.p: The Canadian Air Line Pilots Association (CALPA) said 900 unionised pilots for Air Canada's regional airlines Air Ontario, AirBC, Air Alliance and Air Nova will go on strike on January 10.
The union said negotiations between the pilots and Air Canada broke down on December 4 after the airline management refused to negotiate a union proposal.

"We have gone through months of direct negotiations, conciliation and mediation with no resolution. Strike action now seems to be the only way to force meaningful negotiations by our managements," the union said in a statement.

"It's unacceptable for management to enter into bargaining with us on a proposal that could have brought us to an agreement, and then refuse to even negotiate it afterwards, just as it happened on December 4th," the elected chairmen of the four pilots' groups said in a statement.

The union said the pilots for Air Canada's regional subsidiaries operate over 700 flights a day to 70 destinations in Canada and the United States, carrying about four million passengers a year and producing over C$500 million in annual revenues for Air Canada.
